scenes.say: Kiri is a free, open-source container runtime written in Rust, built to replace Docker Desktop. Here's the review in about a minute.

scenes.head: Docker Desktop can idle at 2 to 4.5 GB of RAM
scenes.say: Docker Desktop can hold up to 4.5 gigabytes of RAM before a single container runs.

visual.label: Docker Desktop resident memory, upper end

scenes.speak: Docker Desktop can hold up to four and a half gigabytes of RAM before a single container runs.

scenes.head: One 900 KB agent replaces the daemon stack
scenes.say: Kiri replaces its daemon chain with one 900 kilobyte agent inside a 10 megabyte Linux kernel, and launches containers with a single clone3 system call.
scenes.speak: Kiri replaces its daemon chain with one nine hundred kilobyte agent inside a ten megabyte Linux kernel, and launches containers with a single clone-three system call.

scenes.head: Container start-and-exit in 2.55 ms
scenes.say: Through the Docker Engine API, a container starts and exits in 2.55 milliseconds. Docker Desktop takes 213.
scenes.speak: Through the Docker Engine A.P.I., a container starts and exits in two point five five milliseconds. Docker Desktop takes two hundred thirteen.

visual.label: Start-and-exit latency via the Docker Engine API

scenes.head: Speaks the Docker Engine API natively
scenes.say: The docker CLI and Compose work unchanged, and the VM sleeps when idle, then wakes in 0.15 seconds.
scenes.speak: The docker C.L.I. and Compose work unchanged, and the V.M. sleeps when idle, then wakes in fifteen hundredths of a second.

items: docker, Compose, buildx and Dev Containers work unchanged
Idle sleep after 60 s, 0.15 s wake

scenes.head: host-gateway builds fail, and Winsock behaves differently
scenes.say: Rough edges: host-gateway builds fail, and cancelling a download on Windows can hang until a socket timeout.
scenes.speak: Rough edges: host gateway builds fail, and cancelling a download on Windows can hang until a socket timeout.

scenes.say: It scores nine out of ten overall, with a perfect ten for performance.

scenes.head: Ready for daily development duty
scenes.pros: Single-syscall clone3 spawning: containers start at near-process speed.
scenes.cons: Move BuildKit into the daemon so host-gateway builds just work.
scenes.say: Favorite feature: that single clone3 spawn. What we'd change: build BuildKit into the daemon. Verdict: ready for daily development.
scenes.speak: Favorite feature: that single clone-three spawn. What we'd change: build BuildKit into the daemon. Verdict: ready for daily development.
